name: Latvia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 1860565 inhabitants, recorded as 1.861 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Checked on 2026-07-27 against the theatre index published by the Latvian Ministry of Culture, which groups the country's theatres by who founded them. Two puppet houses meet the denominator. Latvijas Leļļu teātris, Riga, listed among the state theatres, in its own two-storey building on K. Barona iela; its site gives 4 October 1944 as its founding and records that it carried a Latvian and a Russian troupe until the 2022/23 season. Liepājas Leļļu teātris, Rožu laukums 5/6 in Liepāja, listed among the municipal theatres and registered as Pašvaldības SIA, a municipal limited company, which is public backing under the denominator whatever the corporate form. One candidate was examined and set aside: Rēzeknes teātris 'Joriks' is municipal but is a drama house, and it plays in the Culture House of Rēzekne National Societies rather than a building of its own — it fails the denominator twice. The ministry's index does not list it either. The opening estimate of 1 counted the state house and missed the municipal one, which is the error this indicator will make everywhere until each country's index is read.

Web check of 2026-07-27, in the country's own language, redone after the object theatre ruling of the same day. Latvia moves from 0 to 1. The previous pass had found the establishment, read its page and described it correctly, then excluded it on the sole ground that no course title contained the word puppet. That ground no longer exists: object theatre now enters the denominator. The page was re-opened to test what the ruling requires of it, which is not what the previous pass had asked. Read at source: the Latvian Academy of Culture awards a bakalaura grāds dramatiskā teātra aktiera mākslā, four years and eight semesters, and carries within it a named specialisation, Specializācija “Fiziskais un objektu teātris”. Two criteria are satisfied that the earlier reading had not tested. Object theatre is a specialisation of the course and not a subject inside it, which is what separates this case from the Spanish one, where puppetry is a module within an acting curriculum. And the award is state-recognised: the page situates the programme in a valsts akreditētajā studiju virzienā, a state-accredited study direction. Ownership did not have to be argued, the Academy being a state one, but under today's ruling it would not have mattered either way. Lower bound rises from 0 to 1. The upper bound stays at 1 but changes meaning: it carried the object theatre question, which is now answered, and no second Latvian candidate was found by the previous pass.

establishments.name: Latvijas Kultūras akadēmija
establishments.award: Bakalaura grāds dramatiskā teātra aktiera mākslā, specialisation Fiziskais un objektu teātris, 4 years / 8 semesters
establishments.description: The Latvian Academy of Culture runs a four-year bachelor's degree in dramatic theatre acting carrying a named specialisation in physical and object theatre, designed with the Latvian Puppet Theatre. It counts since the ruling of 2026-07-27: the specialism is object theatre taught as a specialism, and the degree sits in a state-accredited study direction.
